Pakistan's natural resources could be worth $8 to $10 trillion, says Ishaq Dar! 🇵🇰
According to Express Tribune, Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar said on Friday that Pakistan's minerals, hydrocarbons and gemstones are conservatively estimated at $8 trillion to $10 trillion. He spoke at Karachi Port while welcoming the Turkish seismic research vessel Oruç Reis. Dar said the seismic survey would take about five to six months, and Turkish Energy Minister Alparslan Bayraktar said the ship would collect 3D seismic data over 670 square kilometres of the Indus offshore basin.
